let num: string | number = "text";
function count() {}
count.property = 1;
console.log(num.toUpperCase());
count.property = (num = 3);
console.log(num.toFixed(1), count.property.toFixed(1));
const label = () => "";
let text: string | number = 1;
label.property = "initial";
console.log(text.toFixed(1));
label.property = (text = "changed");
console.log(text.toUpperCase(), label.property.toUpperCase());
